blind.description: A modular wall segment featuring yellowish wattle-and-daub plaster framed by dark horizontal wooden beams at the top and bottom. Centered horizontally is a small rectangular barred window framed in dark wood, complete with vertical bars and a small open wooden shutter with dark metal hinges attached to one side. The plaster wall exhibits weathered details and patches of eroded stucco revealing the structure beneath. All geometry is solid, cohesive, and sits flush on the ground.
blind.from_above: A narrow horizontal dark brown wooden rectangular beam casting a broad shadow with light filtering through the window bars.
blind.height_vs_figure: Roughly 6 to 6.5 ft tall (slightly taller than the 5 ft 9 in scale marker) and about 3 to 3.5 ft wide.
